baseline_models.focus_anchor: The threefold ج ز ي sequence culminates in مَن وُجِدَ فِى رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزَاؤُهُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reciprocal requital is recast through substitution: passive finding selects a person by the contents of his portable domain, and فَهُوَ makes that person, not merely an imposed fine, stand as the compensating equivalent.

activation_trace.role: Requital matching an act supplies the ordinary punitive frame repeated across the ayah.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the sharper mechanism by which the selected person becomes the countervalue.
Concrete finding supplies the selection event that links an object-location to a person.
The traveler's lodging and effects supply the bounded personal domain in which discovery acquires legal force.

changed_reading.before: The offender receives an unspecified punishment for the loss.
changed_reading.after: Whoever is selected by the finding becomes the compensatory object himself: person and penalty collapse into one term.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وُجِدَ فِى رَحْلِهِ joins passive discovery to the closing label ٱلظَّالِمِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The container acts as an evidentiary boundary: presence inside a person's effects converts spatial inclusion into attributed wrongdoing. The concrete branch of ظلم as putting something in an improper place makes placement itself, not only abstract guilt, a live hinge.

activation_trace.role: Finding makes enclosed presence publicly available as the decisive fact.
Personal lodging and effects turn a mere location into an ownership-like boundary.
Improper placement gives the concluding wrongdoing a material analogue and exposes the inference from misplaced thing to culpable person.

changed_reading.before: The bag is incidental scenery for an otherwise direct proof of theft.
changed_reading.after: The bag is the conversion point where an object's placement is made to define a person's liability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural frame قَالُوا ... كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِى surrounds the sanction formula.
baseline_models.mechanism: Collective speech negotiates a rule and immediately voices its communal application. The answer therefore does more than describe punishment: it authorizes a way of judging another and binds the speakers to it.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation through speech supplies the dialogic act by which the penalty is settled.
Speech exercising judgment over another supplies the performative force latent in their answer.
Repeated requital turns the uttered formula into the group's stated practice.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely report a penalty already fixed elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Their answer is a self-binding speech act that supplies and licenses the sanction about to govern them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition is unequal from the opening of the encounter, while the brothers later appeal to what their interlocutors already know about them. The focus finding can therefore yield a true public location without yielding complete knowledge of agency.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by an identifying trace supplies one side of the encounter's unequal knowledge.
Nonrecognition supplies the other side, leaving the brothers unable to read the agent behind events.
Their appeal to known character distinguishes prior knowledge of persons from the later sign found in a container.
The focus finding supplies a visible fact whose causal history remains outside the speakers' knowledge.

structural_cues: 12:58 opposes his recognition of them to their nonrecognition of him.
12:73 places a claim of already-known noncorruption and non-theft immediately before the penalty exchange.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal recognition, an appeal to prior knowledge, and a later finding; I infer that accurate object-location need not identify the placer. A live alternative is that the recognition contrast concerns identity only and does not qualify the evidentiary inference.

changed_reading.before: Finding the object settles the whole truth of the event.
changed_reading.after: Finding settles a public location inside an epistemically asymmetric encounter, while agency and intention can remain concealed.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier item is deliberately put into the travelers' effects and later found there as returned merchandise. The focus repeats the placement-container-finding script but reverses its social value from concealed provision to incriminating possession.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate transposition supplies an external agent who makes property occupy a traveler's effects.
Trade property supplies the first hidden item whose presence does not imply theft by its container-holder.
The travelers' effects supply the same bounded domain later used to assign liability.
Expected recognition after return makes later discovery the intended result of hidden placement.
Actual finding completes the earlier innocent version of the focus ayah's evidentiary script.
Return to its prior holder marks the concealed possession as restitution rather than culpable taking.

structural_cues: 12:62 explicitly orders placement in the effects; 12:65 reports the resulting finding.
The earlier sequence gives a packet-internal counterexample to inferring agency from enclosed possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an intentional placement followed by discovery in the travelers' effects; I infer that its recurrence activates a moral reversal and destabilizes possession-as-agency. The live alternative is simple logistical repetition without intended legal contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus finding is a transparent discovery of what the selected person put in his own bag.
changed_reading.after: It replays a known hidden-placement script, so identical container evidence can signify gift in one pass and guilt in another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Access to measured provisions is conditioned on bringing the brother, whose safe return is then secured by a solemn pledge. The focus substitution turns that already-pledged person into collateral: detention realizes the risk embedded in the bargain.

activation_trace.role: A barrier between the family and desired provisions supplies the pressure that makes the brother transactional.
Measured food supplies the material benefit made conditional on the brother's presence.
Literal kinship identifies the person whose body and return become terms in the exchange.
Guarding an inviolable bond supplies the brothers' promise to preserve and return him.
The confirmed covenant supplies the personal surety that precedes his conversion into recompense.
Substitution makes the pledged brother stand in place of the missing property and the unmet return.

structural_cues: 12:63 links the brother's presence to release of measure.
12:66 converts his return into a solemn group obligation before 12:75 converts a person into recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a commercial condition, a kinship pledge, and person-as-substitute; I infer a collateralization arc in which detention forecloses on the pledged person. A live alternative is that the pledge remains only moral and never becomes legal surety.

changed_reading.before: The formula concerns only the proper penalty for a newly alleged thief.
changed_reading.after: The formula also realizes an older bargain: the entrusted brother has become the personal collateral through which the transaction closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The missing vessel is first assigned a guaranteed camel-load for its recovery; the focus then assigns the located person as compensation for its loss. Reward and penalty form an asymmetric valuation field that exchanges goods for goods on one side and a person for an object on the other.

activation_trace.role: Loss after prior presence defines the deficit for which both reward and penalty are calculated.
The vessel and measure supply the concrete object placed at the center of valuation.
A visible carried load supplies the material countervalue promised for restoration.
Assumed guarantee makes the announced reward an enforceable commitment rather than loose inducement.
Substitution supplies the counter-scale on which a person stands for the unrecovered object.

structural_cues: 12:72 states a quantified recovery reward and a guarantor.
12:75 answers the corresponding loss with a personal rather than material countervalue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent reward and penalty valuations; I infer a deliberate contrast between material recompense and personal substitution. A live alternative is that the two speech acts are pragmatically separate and not intended as a scale.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states a self-contained punitive custom.
changed_reading.after: It completes a two-sided economy of the missing vessel: recovery is priced in cargo, while possession is priced in a person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The caravan is publicly assigned the thief-label before the missing object is specified; after denial, the accusers ask what its penalty should be if the brothers are lying. Their focus answer is therefore elicited self-binding speech, not a detached legal lecture.

activation_trace.role: Attribution of theft supplies a public identity-label before the evidentiary exchange unfolds.
Inquiry after an absent thing supplies the transition from accusation to specifying the alleged loss.
Negotiating speech supplies the direct question that solicits the brothers' own sanction.
The requested requital frames the focus response as an answer with immediate operative force.
Possible attribution of lying supplies the conditional pressure under which the group defines its exposure.
Their answer exercises judgment over the still-unidentified person and simultaneously binds the speakers.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from public accusation to loss-question, denial, conditional penalty-question, and answer.
The focus begins with their speech and ends with their first-person-plural practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered interrogation and conditional challenge; I infer that the question is designed to obtain an enforceable self-description of penalty. A live alternative is ordinary fact-finding in which the answer merely reports custom.

changed_reading.before: The brothers neutrally explain a standing rule.
changed_reading.after: They are induced to author the exact rule that can be turned back upon their group.

context_deltas.mechanism: The object is explicitly placed in the brother's effects, and the later search is ordered through the other containers before extraction from his. The focus passive 'was found' compresses this causal production into an apparently self-disclosing fact.

activation_trace.role: Intentional making-into-a-state supplies the hidden causal act behind the later location.
The drinking implement supplies the deliberately moved object that will function as evidence.
The brother's effects supply the selected personal enclosure into which the evidence is placed.
A specified beginning supplies deliberate search order rather than spontaneous discovery.
Repeated containment supplies the series of bounded spaces through which suspicion is procedurally staged.
Extraction from concealment supplies the produced reveal that the focus recasts as passive finding.
The passive finding is the compressed endpoint that carries the staged sequence into liability.

structural_cues: 12:70 names an agent who places the object in the brother's effects.
12:76 orders the search and names extraction, surrounding 12:75's agentless passive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies placement, ordered search, and extraction; I infer that the focus passive foregrounds usable proof while backgrounding its producer. A live alternative is that the passive merely keeps attention on the legal condition, without rhetorically concealing agency.

changed_reading.before: The passive reports a chance discovery that triggers a preexisting rule.
changed_reading.after: The passive is the legal surface of a produced evidentiary event whose placement, sequencing, and reveal are controlled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah states that taking the brother was unavailable under the king's governing order except through the disclosed device. The brothers' person-as-recompense formula thus becomes a jurisdictional bridge: their accepted norm supplies custody that the royal norm would not.

activation_trace.role: Strategic contrivance supplies the designed relation between the penalty answer and the desired outcome.
Seizure and detention supply the concrete custody that the focus sanction must authorize.
An order of reckoning and requital supplies the competing normative system under which custody was unavailable.
Royal authority identifies the jurisdiction whose ordinary rule is being traversed.
Person-for-object substitution supplies the alternative rule that makes detention legally available.

structural_cues: 12:76 explicitly connects the device to the otherwise unavailable act of taking the brother.
The focus answer is voiced by the brothers rather than imposed as the king's rule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrivance, inability to take under the king's dīn, and the focus substitution; I infer that the brothers' norm is the operative legal bridge. A live alternative is that dīn denotes broad administrative custom rather than formal jurisdiction, but the cross-order function remains.

changed_reading.before: The ayah only states the customary punishment for possession of stolen property.
changed_reading.after: The stated custom is the hinge that transfers custody across incompatible normative orders.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant ج ز ز target carried by the packet's split mapping for ج ز ي. It remains anchored in the focus's repeated recompense and travel-effects language, where becoming the penalty entails removal from the traveling unit. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary severance image, not as the lexical meaning of جَزَاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Repeated جَزَاء is joined to رَحْل, while the selected person will cease to continue with the travelers.

activation_trace.role: Cutting supplies an exploratory material image for the sanction's severance of one member from the group.
Travel supplies the moving collective from which the selected person is cut.
Removal from a place supplies the sanction's concrete consequence as forced separation.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is only an abstract legal equivalence.
changed_reading.after: As a contained cross-root echo, recompense also cuts the selected traveler out of the journey and makes separation the paid price.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus grammar conventionally directs ٱلظَّالِمِينَ toward punished offenders, whereas the packet reveals another agent who deliberately makes the object occupy the brother's effects. The reading remains anchored in ظلم's improper-placement branch and the exact focus container construction. Downstream prose should retain it as a reflexive moral shadow on the operation, not replace the primary grammatical referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The closing ٱلظَّالِمِينَ follows a rule triggered by what is found inside a person's رَحْل.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in an improper place opens a concrete wrongdoing-frame around the decisive placement.
Deliberate transposition identifies an upstream agent who produces the incriminating state.
The brother's personal effects supply the place made to hold what will define him as liable.
Strategic contrivance confirms that the object's legally potent location was produced rather than accidental.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are exhausted by those in whose effects the object is found.
changed_reading.after: A contained secondary reading lets 'wrongdoing' cast backward onto the engineered misplacement that manufactures that status.

strongest_changes: The person is not merely punished but made to stand as the missing object's countervalue.
Earlier hidden merchandise proves within the packet that finding an item in someone's effects does not disclose who placed it.
Placement, ordered search, and extraction reconstruct the passive finding as a produced evidentiary event.
The brothers' elicited answer supplies a jurisdictional bridge for custody unavailable under the king's governing order.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah concentrates an unusual conversion chain: collective speech turns container-location into culpability, culpability into personal substitution, and that substitution into cross-order custody. Repeated baggage discoveries preserve a live reversal between gift and incrimination, while asymmetric knowledge keeps fact, agency, and moral status from collapsing into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact practical scope of the person-as-recompense formula is not specified by the focus ayah alone.
The earlier benevolent baggage return may be a deliberate causal countermodel or only a repeated logistical motif.
The collateral reading depends on treating the prior covenant and provision bargain as structurally continuous with the later sanction.
The severance and placer-shadow outliers are deliberately form-distant or syntactically secondary and should remain qualified.
